name: @aicr/docs-mdx-gate
description: Pinned MDX toolchain for tools/check-docs-mdx-parse — the blocking docs gate. Plugin set mirrors what Fern renders with (GFM, YAML frontmatter) so the gate agrees with `fern generate --docs`. package-lock.json freezes the FULL transitive tree so the gate's verdict is reproducible: an upstream patch release must not be able to change which docs pass without a repository change.
